title: Dynamic CORS and security headers configuration
description: AWS AppConfig JSON Schema validator. AppConfig rejects any configuration version that fails this schema BEFORE it can be deployed, so a malformed allowlist can never reach production.

items.description: An exact origin. Must be an https:// origin with no path/trailing slash, or the literal localhost origins for local development. The wildcard '*' is intentionally NOT permitted.

securityHeaders.description: Response headers injected on every response, including errors and preflight.
